Two application-auth paths, one user permission model · the IAM entry needs no key pair (the application's identity is its IAM session) · the forwarded SSO token still decides which tools a user sees

mints 8 h caller session · name = actor

The kernel holds exactly one session, minted by the backend for the agent it runs · it cannot assume the caller role itself, so it cannot present another agent's identity
